findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no staff present with adequate knowledge of food safety standards. Proper sanitizer preparation and use could not be demonstrated during today’s visit. The only individual present during the inspection was within the first 30-days of hire and lacked a certified food protection manager or food handler’s certificate. Ensure a person in charge with adequate food safety knowledge is present at all times. Insepctor will follow-up on December 4, 2026 to ensure staff are adequately trained in food safety.
findings.citation_text: 2-101.11(A) Assignment. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, the PERMIT HOLDER shall be the PERSON IN CHARGE or shall designate a PERSON IN CHARGE and shall ensure that a PERSON IN CHARGE is present at the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Inspector observed no staff present during the inspection to have a valid certified food protection manager (CFPM) certificate. The only staff member present was within his first 30 days of hire and lacked any required certification. Ensure at least one CFPM is present at all times of food preparation and service.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no sanitizer available at the start of today’s inspection. The staff member present was educated regarding sanitizer requirements and a quaternary ammonia sanitizer bucket was prepared, measuring 150ppm. Ensure a sanitizer bucket is prepared prior to starting any food preparation or service.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Insepctor observed no stem thermometer available at the facility for measuring the temperature of time/temperature control for safety foods. The staff member present was informed, and he stated that the thermometer has been ordered. The inspector will follow-up on December 4, 2026 to ensure a stem thermometer is available.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 Food Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small-diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets.
